dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: They say that many people have seen the Wild Hunt recently. But somehow... I find that a little hard to believe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to be rather concerned about the Wild Hunt. Are you a Ratnik too?

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not! Surely you can tell from the clothes I'm wearing! I'm no Ratnik... and I'm definitely not brave enough to fight monsters like they do...

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: I'm just your regular merchant who occasionally moves goods for Piramida and sources supplies the Ratniki might need, that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: So, when I'm on the job, I ask about what they know about the Wild Hunt, so I know which roads to avoid and stay safe. I guess that's one perk I enjoy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, many people have said that they've seen the Wild Hunt around?

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: ...Well, many people believe they've seen the Wild Hunt. But it's more likely that what they actually saw was some kind of monster.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: And sometimes, there's another explanation. For merchants like us, it's pretty common to lose or damage some of our goods whenever we travel from place to place.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: Then, when the client asks about it, some people just reflexively blurt out "the Wild Hunt" as an excuse. But of course, that's never actually true.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: But occasionally, some of us do run into the Wild Hunt. When that happens, I notify Piramida through our usual channels.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I really hope that only a few folks have seen the Wild Hunt.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: Yeah, those things are crazy dangerous... If you ever come across them, just run. Nothing's more important than staying alive.
